A0151.title: Phased OTA Deployment and Canary Release
A0151.definition: A strategy of deploying updates through small-scale pilots and gradual rollout to minimize the impact of batch update failures or malicious updates.
A0151.description: Cautious deployment strategy: small-scale canary testing; monitoring device status during updates; emergency suspension on anomalies; A/B testing; automatic rollback mechanism; user-selectable update time.
A0151.limitation: Canary release extends the full deployment cycle, making it difficult for emergency security patches to cover all devices in time; during the canary period, unupdated devices remain exposed to known vulnerabilities. Meanwhile, multiple versions coexisting lead to device fragmentation, increasing the complexity of subsequent operations and vulnerability remediation.
keywords: Phased OTA Deployment and Canary Release
